channel.title: AgentBounty Devlog
channel.description: Short build notes for AgentBounty. Site changes, mechanism updates, operational notes.

item.title: How to qualify for the CAUTIO airdrop — a 10-question FAQ
item.description: Plain-English FAQ on the CAUTIO airdrop: the two ways to qualify (BOUNTY holder tiers and Agent Bounty Plates NFT holders), the community multiplier, the snapshot, how and when you receive tokens, how staking rewards work (CAUTIO emissions plus a real-fee share), supply, and the warnings that matter.

item.title: The Tsubasa Theory of Success
item.description: A manifesto on the permanent underclass of high-agency builders outside the Valley and Mainland China capital nodes — and how the Tsubasa theory hands them their wings.

item.title: Contracts v0.1: design locked, mocks compile, stake-priced multi-submission
item.description: Phase 5 design ratified. Five contracts (two mocks, three core). Multi-submission per bounty with an EIP-1559-style escalating bond — late submitters pay more, above-base portion burned, base bond returned to honest losers and slashed for spam. Mocks compile clean.

item.title: Staking page: snapshot countdown, tiered access, and a redacted token name
item.description: Shipped /staking as the public design surface for the risk-underwriting token. Snapshot in 7 days. Distribution, locks, fee split, and friendly communities are on the page; every number is explicitly subject to change. Name held back behind CSS censor bars.

item.title: Sandwich stack, PLATE as test module, and v0.1 contracts in construction
item.description: 48-hour log: Aeon + Bankr sandwich costed; PLATE claim live on Base as a rehearsal for art-market data brokerage skills; v0.1 escrow contracts being scoped; site log surfaces merged.

item.title: Site scaffold and documentation surface
item.description: Replaced the placeholder with an Astro documentation/roadmap site. First Diataxis surface, six engineering diagrams, sitemap, RSS, and LLM-readable files.
